recruiter.description: Soft skills, motivation and basic technical knowledge

cto.greeting: Hi, I'm {{name}}, CTO / Tech Lead. I'd like to discuss architecture, scalability, and security trade-offs with you.

assessment.title: {{role}} — session summary
assessment.disclaimer: Mock rubric, not a real skill grade — full LLM-based answer grading arrives with on-device inference (DIA-84).

controls.micUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser
controls.notAvailable: Not available in this mock interview

micErrors.no-speech: No speech was picked up. Check that the right microphone is selected, then try again or type your answer.
micErrors.not-allowed: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it via the padlock icon in the address bar and reload the page.
micErrors.audio-capture: No microphone found. Connect one or pick another input device in your system settings.
micErrors.network: The speech recognition service is unreachable. Check your connection and try again, or type your answer.
micErrors.language-not-supported: This browser cannot recognize the selected interview language. Please type your answer instead.
micErrors.busy: The previous recording is still closing. Give it a moment and press again.
micErrors.unknown: Voice input failed. Try again or type your answer.

controls.voiceUnavailable: This browser has no voice for the interview language: the recruiters will all sound alike, or stay silent. The interview works in text — or install the language's speech pack in your system settings.

privacy.note: Everything you type here stays in this browser. Answers, interview history and pipeline progress are saved on this device only and are never sent to a server. Records older than {{days}} days are deleted automatically.
privacy.clearConfirm: Delete all interview history and pipeline progress saved in this browser? This cannot be undone.

engine.title: Local engine check
engine.subtitle: Whether this device can run the interviewer on-device, and what is missing if it cannot.
engine.simdFallback: requires WebAssembly SIMD, which every browser with WebGPU has

reasons.no-webgpu: this browser has no WebGPU — the on-device model needs it
reasons.no-gpu-adapter: WebGPU is present but no GPU adapter was granted
reasons.gpu-error: the graphics driver refused the request
reasons.model-unavailable: the model bundle has not been downloaded to this device yet
reasons.engine-error: the runtime could not start with this model
reasons.no-simd: no WebAssembly SIMD — the runtime this app ships needs it

bundleSource.title: The model bundle
bundleSource.stored: Stored on this device — {{size}} MB, verified and added {{date}}. It stays here until you remove it; nothing is uploaded anywhere.
bundleSource.served: Served from this site, out of public/models/ — the development setup.
bundleSource.why: GitHub serves release downloads without the CORS header a browser needs, so this page cannot fetch the {{size}} MB bundle for you. Download it yourself, then point us at the file: it is checked against a known SHA-256 and stored in this browser, on this device only.
bundleSource.verifying: Checking the file against its SHA-256…
bundleSource.benefit: With the model on this device, the interviewer reacts to your answers instead of reading from a script. Everything still runs in this browser — nothing is uploaded, and it works offline once the file is here.

bundleErrors.no-storage: This browser will not let the page store a file of this size, so the model cannot be kept here.
bundleErrors.insufficient-space: Not enough free space on this device for the bundle.
bundleErrors.checksum-mismatch: That file is not the bundle this app expects — its contents do not match the published SHA-256. It has not been kept.
bundleErrors.wrong-size: That is not the model bundle: the file is the wrong size.
bundleErrors.network-error: The file could not be read to the end.
bundleErrors.storage-error: The file could not be stored on this device.

invite.title: This device can run the interviewer locally.
invite.body: With the model prepared, the interviewer reacts to what you actually said instead of following a script. One {{size}} MB download, kept on this device and never uploaded.
